# Source and license

These fixtures are unmodified copies from
[`bbgdzxng1/interlace-detection-test-patterns`](https://github.com/bbgdzxng1/interlace-detection-test-patterns),
commit `9d163e87b222e2711ab5fae805d80b2e655e04c1`.

They and `generate_test_cases.sh` are licensed under GPL-3.0; the upstream
license text is preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE). The patterns provide TFF,
BFF, progressive, hard-telecined, and soft-telecined inputs with visual field
and cadence indicators.
